Entity.description:
A company, person, place, crypto asset, or city's weather, and the properties Epochal holds for
it. New types can be added, so a client must accept a `type` it doesn't know.

properties.description:
The properties of a crypto asset, which is one coin, not a trading pair. They hold its latest
UTC day, the price at a minute, and the price on a date or the daily history that the URL asks
for. Each day is rolled up from 1-minute bars of the best market Epochal holds for that day.

updated_at.description: When the properties were last refreshed.

type.description: The entity's type. It sets the shape of `properties`.

properties.description:
A place's weather at the instant. It holds the latest report, today's and yesterday's observed
figures, and the forecast, or the observed days of a date or range. Today is the local day of
the instant. The place is a city, a smaller town, or a landmark. A block is `null` when the
view doesn't ask for it or the place has no data for it. No block names the source of its
values.

schema_version.description: The version of the type's property layout. It is `1` for every type.

updated_at.description: When the properties were last refreshed.

type.description: The entity's type. It sets the shape of `properties`.

properties.description: The properties of a place, which is a business or point of interest, as of the instant.

name.description: The company's common name, such as `NVIDIA`.

legal_name.description: The company's full legal name, such as `NVIDIA Corporation`. `null` when unknown.

description.description: What the company does, in its own words, as plain text. `null` when unknown.

tagline.description: The company's one-line headline, in its own words. `null` when unknown.

domain.description: The website's host without scheme or path, such as `nvidia.com`. `null` when unknown.

industry.description:
The primary industry as the profile names it, such as `Computer Hardware Manufacturing`.
`null` when unknown.

specialties.description: The specialties the company lists, distinct, in profile order.

founded_year.description: The year it was founded. `null` when unknown.

employee_count.description: The number of employees on the profile. `null` when unknown.

headquarters.description: Where the company is headquartered. `null` when no part is known.

revenue_range.description: The annual revenue band. `null` when unknown.

ticker.description: The stock ticker of the listing, such as `NVDA`. `null` when not listed or unknown.

exchange.description: The listing's exchange code as the profile writes it, such as `NASDAQ`. `null` when unknown.

latest_funding_round.description: The same round as `funding_rounds[0]`. `null` when `funding_rounds` is empty.

funding_rounds.description: Dated rounds announced on or before `updated_at`, newest first, without exact duplicates.

headline.description: A one-line professional summary. `null` when unknown.

summary.description: The person's own description of themselves. `null` when unknown.

industry.description: The industry as the profile names it. `null` when unknown.

location.description: Where the person is based. `null` when both parts are unknown.

follower_count.description: The number of followers of the professional profile. `null` when unknown.

experience.description: Positions, current ones first, then the most recent end or start date first.

education.description: Periods of study, most recent first.

skills.description: The skills the person lists, distinct, in profile order.

languages.description: Languages the person speaks, distinct by name.

posts.description: Recent posts dated on or before `updated_at`, newest first.

symbol.description: The asset's symbol at the instant, such as `BTC`.

currency.description:
The currency of `latest` and `range_52w`, such as `USDT`. Every other priced object names
its own currency, and `chart` is in the currency of `quote`.

stale_hours.description:
Hours since the last trade (`latest.through`), rounded up, when that trade is more than 24
hours before the instant. The price is then not current. `null` otherwise.

latest.description: The UTC day that contains the instant, up to the instant. `null` when no price is visible.

range_52w.description: The low and high of the 365 UTC days to `latest.date`, in `currency`. `null` without `latest`.

quote.description: The price at the URL's `at`, or at the latest minute when the URL has no `at`.

chart.description:
The price every hour over the 24 hours to `quote.at`, in the currency of `quote`. `null`
when no minute in those hours is visible.

price_on_date.description: The UTC day of the URL's `date`, clipped to the instant. `null` without `date`.

price_history.description: Daily bars for the URL's `from` and `to`. `null` without `from`.

CryptoProperties.description:
The properties of a crypto asset, which is one coin, not a trading pair. They hold its latest
UTC day, the price at a minute, and the price on a date or the daily history that the URL asks
for. Each day is rolled up from 1-minute bars of the best market Epochal holds for that day.

region.description: The first-level administrative area, such as a state. `null` when unknown.

location.description: The place's coordinates, to two decimals.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone. Every local date in these properties is in it.

current.description:
The latest report. Filled in the default view, and for a `?date=` of today or a later day
that a run covers.

today.description: Today so far. Filled in the default view only.

yesterday.description: The local day before `today`. Filled in the default view only.

forecast.description:
The forecast from the newest run published by the instant. Filled in the default view, for a
`?date=` of today or a later day that a run covers, and for a `?from=&to=` that ends after
today, with `daily` cut to the range.

days.description:
The days of `?date=` (one) or `?from=&to=` (each local day of the range up to today),
oldest first. `null` in the default view and for a range that starts after today.

WeatherProperties.description:
A place's weather at the instant. It holds the latest report, today's and yesterday's observed
figures, and the forecast, or the observed days of a date or range. Today is the local day of
the instant. The place is a city, a smaller town, or a landmark. A block is `null` when the
view doesn't ask for it or the place has no data for it. No block names the source of its
values.

category.description:
The main category, as the map labels it, such as `Historical landmark`. It is normally
`categories[0]`. `null` when unknown.

description.description: What the place is, in a sentence or two. `null` when unknown.

summary.description: A longer account of the place, one paragraph per entry.

address.description: The street address. `null` when no part is known.

location.description: The place's coordinates. `null` when unknown or out of range.

phone.description: The phone number, as the map lists it. `null` when unknown.

website.description: The place's own website, a full URL. `null` when unknown.

opening_hours.description: Opening hours per weekday, Monday first, in zero to seven rows.

rating.description: A summary of the place's reviews. `null` when neither score nor count is known.

PlaceProperties.description: The properties of a place, which is a business or point of interest, as of the instant.

formatted.description: The whole address on one line.

Address.description: A postal address. Any part may be `null`.

min_usd.description: The band's lower bound. `0` for the lowest band.

max_usd.description: The band's upper bound. `null` for the open top band.

RevenueRange.description: An annual revenue band, in US dollars per year.

round_type.description: The kind of round. `null` when unknown.

announced_on.description: The day the round was announced. `null` when unknown.

amount.description: The amount raised, in `currency`. `null` when undisclosed.

currency.description: The currency of `amount`. `null` exactly when `amount` is `null`.

investors.description: The investors named for the round, in source order.

formatted.description: The place as one line, such as `Austin, Texas, United States`. `null` when unknown.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, uppercase. `null` when unknown.

start_date.description: When the position started. `null` when unknown.

end_date.description: When the position ended. `null` when ongoing or unknown.

is_current.description: Whether the person holds the position now. `null` when unknown.

location.description: Where the position is based, as written. `null` when unknown.

description.description: What the role involved, in the person's words. `null` when unknown.

Experience.description: A position a person holds or held.

degree.description: The degree earned, as written, such as `MSEE`. `null` when unknown.

field_of_study.description: The field of study, as written. `null` when unknown.

start_date.description: When the study started. `null` when unknown.

end_date.description: When the study ended. `null` when unknown.

proficiency.description: How well the person knows the language. `null` when unknown.

text.description: The post's text, or the text it reposts when it adds none.

like_count.description: The number of likes. `null` when unknown.

comment_count.description: The number of comments. `null` when unknown.

Currency.description: A currency: an ISO 4217 code, or a crypto quote asset such as `USDT`.

open.description: The price at the start of the day's first bar.

close.description: The price at the end of the day's last bar, or the last price while `partial` is true.

volume.description: The coin traded, in coin units to two decimals.

quote_volume.description: The value traded in `currency`, to two decimals. `null` when the market does not publish it.

trades.description: The number of trades. `null` when the market does not publish it.

currency.description: The currency of the day's prices.

previous_close.description: The previous UTC day's close. `null` without a previous day.

change_pct.description: `change` as a percentage of `previous_close`. `null` without a previous day.

partial.description: Whether the day is still in progress at the instant.

through.description: The start of the last minute the day includes.

CryptoDay.description: One UTC day of trading, rolled up from 1-minute bars.

PriceRange.description: The lowest and highest price over a span.

at.description:
The start of the minute. This is the URL's `at` rounded down to the minute, or
`latest.through` when the URL has no `at`.

price.description: The price at the end of the minute.

prices.description: One price per step that has one, oldest first.

PriceChart.description: Prices, oldest first. The field that holds the chart says what span it covers and how often.

date.description:
The UTC day returned. This is `requested_date`, or the day that contains the instant when
that day is earlier.

open.description: The price at the start of the day's first bar.

close.description: The price at the end of the day's last bar, or the last price while `partial` is true.

volume.description: The coin traded, in coin units to two decimals.

quote_volume.description: The value traded in `currency`, to two decimals. `null` when the market does not publish it.

trades.description: The number of trades. `null` when the market does not publish it.

currency.description: The currency of the day's prices.

previous_close.description: The previous UTC day's close. `null` without a previous day.

change_pct.description: `change` as a percentage of `previous_close`. `null` without a previous day.

partial.description: Whether the day is still in progress at the instant.

through.description: The start of the last minute the day includes.

CryptoPriceOnDate.description: The UTC day of the requested `date`, clipped to the instant.

from.description: The first date asked for, inclusive.

to.description: The last date asked for, inclusive, clipped to the instant.

bars.description: One row per day, oldest first.

CryptoPriceHistory.description:
Daily bars, one per UTC day with data. The last bar is the partial day when the range reaches
the instant.

observed_at.description: Observation time, or the time a model estimate is valid for.

model_estimate.description:
Whether the value is a model estimate, used when no station is near or none has filed in 3
hours.

humidity_pct.description: Relative humidity, in percent. `null` when the report lacks a temperature or dew point.

wind.description: The wind. `null` when the report has no wind group.

condition.description: The weather or sky condition. `null` when the report has neither.

WeatherCurrent.description:
The latest observation, or the model's estimate for a place with no station near it or whose
station has filed nothing in the last 3 hours.

status.description: How final the observed figures are. `null` for a date after the instant.

model_estimate.description: Whether the figures are a model estimate for a place with no station near it.

hourly.description: The day's observations. Filled only for a `?date=` of a day up to the instant.

WeatherDay.description: One local day: `today`, `yesterday`, or a day of `days`.

issued_at.description: The initialization time of the run that `hourly` comes from.

daily.description: Up to 15 local days from today, each from the newest run that covers it.

WeatherForecast.description: The forecast from the newest run published by the instant.

hours.description: The hours as the map writes them, such as `9 am to 12 am`, or `Closed`.

PlaceOpeningHours.description: The hours a place is open on one weekday.

score.description: The average star rating, 1 to 5. `null` when unknown.

review_count.description: How many reviews the place has. `null` when unknown.

distribution.description: Reviews per star level, from 1 to 5, ascending. It has exactly five rows, or none when unknown.

PlaceRating.description: A summary of a place's reviews.

detected_at.description:
When the map first showed the current non-open state. `null` for an open place or when
unknown.

PlaceStatus.description: A place's state and, when it is not open, when the map first showed it.

FundingRoundType.description: The kind of a funding round, from the source's funding types.

id.description:
The entity's URL, such as `https://world.epochal.com/organization/<id>`, or the URL of a
page of one. `null` when the reference has no link, even if the entity has a page.

EntityRef.description: A reference to another entity or page.

PartialDate.description: A date to the precision the source states: `1993`, `1993-04`, or `1993-04-05`.

LanguageProficiency.description: How well a person speaks a language, from the profile's five levels.

PricePoint.description: A price at a point in time.

volume.description: The coin traded, in coin units to two decimals.

currency.description: The currency of the row's prices.

CryptoDailyBar.description: One UTC day's prices, in its `currency`.

Temperature.description:
A temperature in both units. The report's own unit is exact, and the other is converted and
rounded to 0.1.

direction_deg.description:
The direction the wind blows from, in degrees clockwise from north. `null` for a calm or
variable wind.

label.description: The code in words, such as `Partly cloudy`.

Condition.description: A WMO weather code and its label.

WeatherStatus.description:
How final a day's observed figures are.

- `preliminary`: Issued during the day, before the figure is settled.
- `final`: The settled figure, or a correction of it.
- `not_reported`: No report is visible at the instant.

temperature.description: Temperature at the end of the step.

condition.description: The day's most significant weather condition.

WeatherForecastDay.description: The forecast of one local day: a row of `forecast.daily`.

Weekday.description: A day of the week. Values not listed may appear.

PlaceStarCount.description: How many reviews gave one star level.

PlaceState.description:
Whether a place is open.

- `closed`: Permanently closed.
- `removed`: Gone from the map.
